maxVersionNote: 1.0.1 reads the type and shape tokens (--ds-weight-*, --ds-size-*, --ds-leading-display, --ds-tracking-display, --ds-btn-radius, --ds-card-radius) in the rules of the roles this contract declares, and the colour roles systems define (the second colour takes accent-on-ink and accent-band; the on-ink soft words are a mix of on-ink); src/lib/ds-slot.ts and the layout load data/ds-slot.css as in Tracy Base. 1.0.0 did not read the type and shape tokens (ROLE-1) and read two roles no system defines (DEF-1), so the contract starts at 1.0.1
applies: data/ds-slot.css read per request by src/lib/ds-slot.ts; the template reads every value as var(--ds-*, <its own value>)
readsRolesNote: src/styles/tokens.css and global.css read every standard role variable, or declare it unused with a reason (ds-not-used) or keep it (ds-keep); the type and shape tokens are read with the 1.0.0 value as the fallback
modesNote: the light/dark switch (data-theme on html, [data-theme-toggle] in Header.astro)

contrast.heading: body :is(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6)
contrast.text: body :is(p, li, a, span, small, label, td, th, dd, dt, blockquote, figcaption, button)
contrast.block-text: body div:not(:has(> :is(div, p, ul, ol, section, article, header, footer, nav, main, aside, figure, table, form, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6)))
